prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: Strictly registered black-and-white segmentation matte for an existing eight-frame animation sprite sheet.
Input image: The attached 960×640 RGBA sprite sheet is the exact segmentation target, not a creative style reference. It has four columns and two rows, eight cells, each 240×320 pixels. Pose order is row-major: 0,1,2,3 in the first row, 4,5,6,7 in the second.
Primary request: Convert this exact input into a foreground matte that retains each original person INCLUDING ALL SHOES and excludes the circular pale-pink display plinth under their feet. Output only a matte, never a new character or colored render.
Registration invariants: Preserve the exact 960×640 canvas, cell positions, pose contours, head/body/limb/shoe proportions, the full raised and open hands, every gap between limbs and body, and the person-to-person alignment. Do not move, redraw creatively, rotate, rescale, crop, center, straighten, change poses, change gestures or add missing details. Trace the exact input silhouettes in-place. Do not add cell borders or labels.
Matte values: Fill every pixel belonging to each person from hair down to the bottom of the existing shoe soles with pure white (#FFFFFF), with only minimal edge antialiasing. White is a solid silhouette with no internal shading or facial/clothing details. Fill all original transparent/background regions with pure black (#000000). Crucially, the entire wide round/cylindrical pale-pink plinth in every cell must also be pure black, including its top visible around and between the shoes, front wall, edges and shadow. Shoes themselves must stay white; do not cut off or shorten their soles. The narrow negative gap between the legs and between the two shoes must remain black exactly as in the input.
Output: One opaque RGB black-and-white image, same aspect ratio and exact alignment as the input. No text, no watermark, no border, no additional object. The matte will be used only to remove plinth-region alpha from the original pixels; generated person RGB will never be used. Generate exactly one image.
review: 실제 출력 및 신발 확대 오버레이 확인: 검은 배경 위8개 흰 인물 실루엣이며 넓은 플린스 형상은 없다. 그러나 입력960×640과 달리 출력1536×1024이고,960×640 단순 축소 후 몸 IoU는0.714~0.939, 중심은 오른쪽0.69~6.99px·위1.01~1.60px 이동한다. 프레임3·7 등에서 신발 옆 경계가 벗어난다. 엄밀한 정합 마스크로는 부적합하여 그대로 적용하면 신발을 깎거나 받침대 일부를 남길 수 있다. 원본 인물 RGB를 절대 교체하지 말고 추가 정합 및 원본 신발 경계 확인이 필요하다. 이 작업에서는 원본에 마스크를 적용하지 않았고 재시도하지 않았다.

registration_review.resampling: Analysis only: sharp resize to 960x640, grayscale, threshold 127. Original mask file preserved unchanged.
